ONE STRING IS ONE PRINTED LINE. A MEMBER is `name`; its `note` lines are printed inside one pair of full-width parentheses right after the name, and its `after` lines (the reason it was published) follow the closing parenthesis on a line of their own -- except an `after` that opens with a lone full stop, which stays on the parenthesis. A TEXT piece publishes no name (check 26b skips it). Write one sentence per line: the generator puts the line breaks in, and the parentheses around a note are never written here.
Every member after the first starts a new printed line that opens with the full-width slash, so a line that does not open with one continues the member above it.
